resources.string: Links drop: the other device moves away, restarts or stops its server. Keep a connection to the simulated sensor alive here, then press Stop and Start on the sensor phone and watch how this phone gets back.

Each attempt is a direct connect that gives up after %1$d s. Between attempts the wait grows from %2$d s, doubling each time up to %3$d s, with 20%% jitter so many phones do not retry in step. It gives up when the failed attempts in a row reach %4$d.

One autoConnect request that waits and connects when the device advertises again. It is slower, but it uses little power while waiting. It can only find the same address, and a phone that is not bonded changes its random address whenever it restarts advertising, so after 30 s without luck this phone scans for the sensor again.
